title: FlagBulkJob
description: A bulk flag job; progress is processedCount / totalCount

comment.description: Reason text, recorded on every moved flag's history

requestedCount.description: The match count the user saw when submitting

totalCount.description: Ids snapshotted at submit: the oldest matches, at most 2,000

processedCount.description: Snapshot ids already run (moved or skipped)

skippedCount.description: Snapshot ids not moved: status changed or flag deleted since the snapshot

skippedFlagIds.description: The skipped ids; only on GET /flags/bulk-jobs/{id} once the job has finished

errorCode.description: STALLED (the run stopped heartbeating) or EXECUTE_ERROR (a chunk kept failing)
